verdicts.reason: A keeps the original order (product → headline → subcopy → CTA) and the headline dominates. But the SOLSTICE logo is shrunk to an unreadable speck in the top-right corner, the can is small, and the subcopy is jammed between the headline and the CTA. B has the same unreadable logo. It also moves the headline up so it is crammed right under the NEW FLAVOR badge, and pushes the can down into a gap between the subcopy and the CTA, which breaks the original's product-first hierarchy. B's spacing is uneven too: a tight top block over a loose middle.
